name: solid_sustained
title: Solid-fuel model: is the flame sustained?
target_label: source states the flame burned or spread at this condition

dropped_features.gravity_g: every verified solid test point is microgravity: one gravity level, so dropped

notes: Groups are investigations; BASS-II is split into its six investigator test series, which used different sample geometries. Groups with fewer than 5 rows are merged for splitting only.
BASS-II pressure is taken as 1 atm (stated for the fabric tests; same glovebox for the rest).
Most extinction points in the BASS-II appendix are given as fan settings with no cm/s value and cannot be used, so sustained points are over-represented.
